t: You're standing at Motherfigure, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill, the British sculptor who lived from 1921 to 2020. His long association with clay began in pottery and developed into sculpture, from small works to large ones. He also produced portrait heads, paintings and drawings. Thornhill evolved a way of working that dispensed with the armature, allowing him to improvise as he modelled. Take a moment to walk around the piece and notice how freely the form seems to have been made.
